So what I wanted to know is with the naturalists new promo he can activate multiple animal symbol texts at once. His promo says that you can choose 1 animal symbol text to activate till the end of your next turn. Then you may play or draw a card. So what I want to know is this: Say that I have the form card for gazelle on my field and I use the promo cards ability to use crocoile add effects. Do I get to use both gazelle and croc effects on a cards like "bestial shift", "natural form's power", and "primal charge" ? Or do I just choose one of the symbol texts ?

 

Since both animal symbols say that I may use them I would assume that I can use both effects But I wanted to get a general opinion or find out if someone know any official ruelings. If you have any questions or need something cleared up please let me know. Thank you for your time.

posts.cooked:
Being able to use multiple symbols at once seems to be the entire point behind his new promo- but it'll also make getting out a permanent form a bit harder since you can't use his innate power to search it.

I think the new version will actually be more useful than his old version, as being able to activate two or even all three effects of a one-shot (by activating Hunted Naturalist two turns in a row with a form card already in play) would basically double or triple the usefulness of such cards.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
With Naturalist's promo, if you have a form card in play you can activate a second form with your power.  That activated form lasts until the end of your next turn, so your next turn you can choose the third form and play Primal Charge using all 3 abilities.

Bestial Shift is actually not as good with the promo most of the time, because you really want 2-3 powers in play, and that isn't as easy to pull off with this Naturalist.

Promo is fun, but you lose a lot not being able to pull a damage taken -1 or +1 damage dealt from your deck or trash.
